title: Ruined Rice Fields and Broken Rail Lines: Sri Lanka Counts Cost of Cyclone
content: Officials estimate the damage runs into billions of dollars, a headache for the island nation just recovering from an economic crash.

title: How Israel’s Settlement Surge in the West Bank Is Displacing Palestinians
content: The Israeli government authorized 22 settlements in May, the largest expansion in decades, and Palestinian families are now being forced from their homes.

title: Spain Sees Itself as a Beacon for Immigrants. So Do Many Latin Americans.
content: The government presents its migrant policy as a welcoming alternative to U.S. crackdowns. But activists say those arriving on boats from Africa are excluded from that embrace.

title: Snail Theft Hits France Before Holiday Rush
content: Shop owners say the thieves who took 990 pounds of snails must have been escargot cognoscenti.

title: The Diplomat Who Was Accused of Sexual Abuse but Kept His Job
content: President William Ruto faces pressure after a Times investigation showed that his government downplayed or ignored the mistreatment of women working in Saudi Arabia.

title: Macron Urges Xi to Help End War in Ukraine
content: As President Emmanuel Macron of France visited China, its leader, Xi Jinping, said his country would play a constructive role in ending the fighting.

title: Hamas Returns Body of Last Thai Hostage in Gaza
content: The militant group took more than 250 hostages from Israel on Oct. 7, 2023, including 31 from Thailand. The remains of all but one other hostage, an Israeli, have been recovered.

title: Taiwan’s Opposition Leader, Once for Independence, Turns Toward China
content: She says Taiwan must embrace its Chinese heritage to avoid war. Her critics say she wants to steer the island into Beijing’s orbit.

title: What to Know About Putin’s Visit to India as Oil Trade Dries Up
content: The Trump administration, which crippled Russia’s oil sales to India with sanctions, will be watching Mr. Putin’s talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

title: Trump Faces Choices on Russia-Ukraine Talks as Peace Deal Deadline Passes
content: The president wanted Moscow and Kyiv to come to terms by Thanksgiving. Negotiations are now stalled, leaving the White House to decide if an agreement is possible anytime soon.

title: In Yemen, Separatist Forces Backed by UAE March Into Oil-Rich Region
content: The separatists were battling to secure the region’s oil fields, residents and the group’s officials said. Their swift advance could be a turning point in Yemen’s decade-long civil war.

title: China, Japan and a New Narrative About World War II
content: Arguments about history are proliferating as the postwar order led by the United States crumbles.

title: What to Know About Trump’s Threat of Military Action in Venezuela
content: The president has warned that the United States could soon expand its attacks from boats near the coast to targets inside Venezuela, but he has also spoken by phone to its leader.

title: Ludwig Minelli, Founder of Swiss Assisted-Suicide Group, Dies at 92
content: Dignitas has helped more than 3,000 people take their own lives, an act that Mr. Minelli maintained was a fundamental exercise of free will.

title: Yegor Ligachev, Gorbachev’s No. 2 Who Turned Foe, Is Dead at 100
content: As the Kremlin’s hard-line Communist ideologist, he initially embraced his boss’s modernizing reforms before turning against them as threats to the Soviet order.
